properties.name: flint.datasource.generate-unique-name
properties.description: Whether to generate a random datasource name (`generate-unique-name`, default true).

properties.name: flint.datasource.name
properties.description: Datasource name to use if "generate-unique-name" is false. Defaults to "testdb" when using an embedded database, otherwise null.

properties.name: flint.datasource.type
properties.description: Fully qualified name of the DataSource implementation to use. By default, a connection pool implementation is auto-detected from the build.

properties.name: flint.datasource.driver-class-name
properties.description: Fully qualified name of the JDBC driver. Auto-detected based on the URL by default.

properties.name: flint.datasource.embedded-database-connection
properties.description: Connection details for an embedded database. Defaults to the most suitable embedded database available in the build.

properties.name: flint.datasource.xa.properties
properties.description: Properties to pass to the XA data source.

properties.name: flint.jdbc.template.ignore-warnings
properties.description: Whether to ignore JDBC statement warnings (SQLWarning). When set to false, throw an SQLWarningException instead.

properties.name: flint.jdbc.template.fetch-size
properties.description: Number of rows that should be fetched from the database when more rows are needed. Use -1 to use the JDBC driver's default configuration.

properties.name: flint.jdbc.template.max-rows
properties.description: Maximum number of rows. Use -1 to use the JDBC driver's default configuration.

properties.name: flint.jdbc.template.query-timeout
properties.description: Query timeout. Default is to use the JDBC driver's default configuration. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: flint.jdbc.template.skip-results-processing
properties.description: Whether results processing should be skipped. Can be used to optimize callable statement processing when we know that no results are being passed back.

properties.name: flint.jdbc.template.skip-undeclared-results
properties.description: Whether undeclared results should be skipped.

properties.name: flint.jdbc.template.results-map-case-insensitive
properties.description: Whether execution of a CallableStatement will return the results in a Map that uses case-insensitive names for the parameters.
